purpose: Six-node telemetry mapping and benign-only detector calibration contract

latency.definition: mean cumulative application latency in ms from sensor task emission to receipt at that logical node during the interval
latency.missing_receipts: excluded from latency mean; loss/availability capture missing tasks

packet_loss.definition: 1 - (number of expected task IDs received at that node within the 500 ms deadline / 8)
packet_loss.sensor: 0.0 because all 8 task IDs are generated locally

utilization.definition: maximum over that node's active Mininet interfaces of interval byte-rate / configured interface capacity, clipped to [0,1]
utilization.reason: deterministic node-level observable; avoids averaging away a congested interface

availability.definition: number of expected task IDs received at that node during the interval / 8

sensor_quality.definition: fraction of task payloads present at that node whose value is within absolute tolerance 0.05 of deterministic evaluator ground truth
sensor_quality.sensor: fraction of generated payloads within tolerance

detector_score.definition: benign-calibrated empirical tail anomaly score using only latency, packet_loss, utilization, availability
detector_score.calibration_scope: per node and per base feature using benign emulator calibration intervals only
detector_score.feature_tail_score: For a value x, empirical one-sided tail score = count of benign calibration values at least as extreme as x divided by (n+1), with numerator using 1 + count; anomaly = 1 - tail_probability.
detector_score.node_combination: maximum anomaly across the four observable base features

integrity: Do not change mapping after non-benign outcomes are observed.
Do not fit or fine-tune MissionShield on emulator data.
Do not replace original E1 normalization.
Do not select a horizon based on emulator outcomes; evaluate H10/H30/H60.
E10-D v7 remains a smoke validation and is not used to calibrate detector_score.
